An existing county road of 1.2 miles would be rerouted over the previously mined area following completion of operation. A 2.5 mile haul road outside of the mined area will be constructed covering approximately 76 acres. This road would be utilized to haul coal to the truck dump. 2.5 miles of powerline would be relocated and 2.5 miles of additional power line would be constructed (Map No. I-5).
Mining facilities to handle increased production on Tract II would be constructed near the railroad loop and would consist of a truck dump, crushers, coal storage, loading hoppers, shop, warehouse and service and storage buildings. The Tract II mining facilities would encompass approximately 300 acres.
Either level of mining will require temporary realignment of the County roads that traverse the mined areas. The present plans are to relocate the county roads gradually and then return them to approximately their original locations when mining is completed. These temporary realignments and subsequent relocations of existing transporation facilities are the responsibility of the mining companies and will be identified in the mining plans submitted for approval.
At this time approximately 161 acre feet of ground water are pumped annually for the Tract III facilities, of which 50 acre feet are consumptively used and the balance being utilized for dust control. Tract III water requirements are assumed to be identical to those of Tract III.
During operation a maximum level of production employment of 340 personnel would be required on Tract III and 200 on Tract II.
